terms.comment: Indeclinable. We have found no Latin name for the island: Morgan–Owens lists Bali among the islands of Indonesia without a Latin form.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. Indonesia islands: Bali (no Latin given).
